concerns.text: FR-010 proposes min‑max scaling of fluorescence quantum yield (FQY) values, yet FQY is intrinsically bounded in [0, 1]. Scaling a quantity already in that interval adds no information and can introduce distortion: test molecules with a true FQY above the training‑set maximum would be mapped to values >1, violating the defined target range. Moreover, the subsequent clipping to [ε, 1‑ε] contradicts the scaling step. This creates a circular/tautological validation where the model is evaluated on a transformed target that is not the physical property of interest, undermining the scientific claim that the GNN predicts fluorescence efficiency.
